mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_cry_check (baby_no, avg_pitch, avg_volume, duration_seconds, pattern, ai_result_json) VALUES (#{babyNo}, #{avgPitch}, #{avgVolume}, #{durationSeconds}, #{pattern}, #{aiResultJson})
mapper.select: SELECT c.cry_check_no, c.baby_no, c.avg_pitch, c.avg_volume, c.duration_seconds, c.pattern, c.ai_result_json, c.reg_time FROM tbl_cry_check c JOIN tbl_baby_info b ON c.baby_no = b.baby_no WHERE c.cry_check_no = #{cryCheckNo} AND b.email = #{email}

SELECT c.cry_check_no, c.baby_no, c.avg_pitch, c.avg_volume, c.duration_seconds, c.pattern, c.ai_result_json, c.reg_time FROM tbl_cry_check c JOIN tbl_baby_info b ON c.baby_no = b.baby_no WHERE c.baby_no = #{babyNo} AND b.email = #{email} ORDER BY c.reg_time DESC
